subject: Supplier access, PO setup & diversity due diligence
messages:
From: Amelia Reed <amelia.reed@greenlinetech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@greenlinetech.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Supplier diversity & onboarding — kickoff and docs request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on — Greenline is ready to start formal onboarding with Redwood. Procurement has a short kickoff checklist we use for new suppliers. To get us moving, can you confirm the following and share the appropriate forms?

- Primary contact for vendor setup and who will own vendor profile
- Copy of W-9 (or W-8 if applicable) and remittance/payee name
- Bank/payment details (ACH) and invoice instructions
- Do you have a supplier diversity or minority-owned certification on file? If so, what class (MBE/WBE/DBE)?
- Modern slavery / human trafficking statement (we collect this for our Tier 1 vendors)
- Any standard lead times for generating purchase orders and receiving vendor codes in your ERP

We typically ask for the documents to be returned within 5 business days to avoid delays to the first PO. I attached our procurement requirements summary for reference.

Thanks,
Amelia Reed
Senior Procurement Manager
Greenline Technologies
(555) 322-0198
Attachment: Greenline_Procurement_Requirements.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Reed <amelia.reed@greenlinetech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier diversity & onboarding — kickoff and docs request

Hi Amelia — great to hear from you and welcome. I'm the vendor owner for this onboarding; Jordan (finance) and Vanessa (compliance) are looped for the PO/payment and diversity checks.

Quick answers and next steps:

- Primary contact: jonas_weber@redwood.ai (me).
- W-9: attached (RWI_W9_Form.pdf). Please confirm if you need a company legal name variant — our legal is "Redwood Inference, Inc.".
- Bank/payment: we prefer ACH (Net 30 by default). I included our banking remittance instructions in the vendor checklist. If Greenline requires different terms, let us know and we can route to Finance for approval.
- Diversity certification: Redwood is not currently certified as an MBE/WBE/DBE. We do maintain a supplier diversity policy and a third-party audit of our supplier sourcing practices; Vanessa will outline acceptable evidence.
- Modern slavery statement: we have a standard supplier-facing statement and a brief questionnaire for our own vendors. I've attached our vendor onboarding checklist which includes the modern slavery attestation block.
- PO turnaround: once vendor profile is created in our ERP and tax/bank info validated, POs can be issued within 2 business days for standard requests. Expedited POs can be requested via jordan_blake@redwood.ai.

Action items for Greenline: please return the completed onboarding checklist and your diversity certificate if available. Vanessa — can you confirm whether the attached checklist plus Greenline's diversity cert will be sufficient, or if we should ask for a specific third-party attestation?

I attached: RWI_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, RWI_W9_Form.pdf

Best,
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Partnerships (Vendor Ops)
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai

From: Amelia Reed <amelia.reed@greenlinetech.com>
To: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procure@greenlinetech.com
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier diversity & onboarding — kickoff and docs request

Jonas — thanks for the quick reply. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- We can accept a company modern slavery statement in lieu of specialized certification, but for supplier diversity we prefer a formal certificate where available.
- Payment terms: Greenline's standard is Net 45, but we can agree to Net 30 on a case-by-case basis if Redwood provides a written confirmation of standard invoice format (PO number, remit address, tax ID).
- Please confirm the name that will appear on invoices (legal vs. DBA).

I've attached our diversity certificate (Greenline_Diversity_Cert.pdf) for your records — it's for a subcontractor we frequently engage.

Also: can we schedule a short 20-minute call tomorrow morning (May 22) to walk through the checklist and ensure the PO path is clear? Our procurement lead is available between 9:00–11:00 PT.

Regards,
Amelia
Attachment: Greenline_Diversity_Cert.pdf

From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Amelia Reed <amelia.reed@greenlinetech.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Supplier diversity & onboarding — kickoff and docs request

Hi Amelia — call works. I've booked 20 minutes at 09:30 PT tomorrow (May 22) and sent a calendar invite to your address.

Quick confirmations for the thread so Finance can proceed:
- Invoices should show legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.; PO# must be present in header; remit address on the attached checklist is acceptable.
- We can accept the Greenline diversity certificate as part of initial evidence; Vanessa will perform the quick intake and advise if a third-party cert is required for ongoing reporting.
- Payment terms: we'll process under Net 30 for the first two POs; if Greenline requires Net 45, Jordan will flag for review (procurement credit terms).

Jordan — can you start the vendor code creation once we have the filled checklist and bank details? Vanessa — please confirm whether Greenline_Diversity_Cert.pdf satisfies our intake or if you need additional documentation.

Thanks and speak tomorrow,
Jonas

--
Jonas Weber
Head of Strategic Partnerships (Vendor Ops)
Redwood Inference
jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Attachments: RWI_Vendor_Onboarding_Checklist.xlsx, RWI_W9_Form.pdf
